entries.title: TCP Type Enhancements
body: You can select a specific TCP traceroute when you configure a Cloud Path probe:
- Resilient TCP Type: Traceroute when the TCP connection fails and then retries using the Conventional TCP type.
- Strict TCP Type: Traceroute when the TCP connection fails and there are no other connections to fall back to.
The Conventional TCP type is the original TCP traceroute based on sync (SYN) packets and is potentially blocked by firewalls.

Any probe configured with a TCP type prior to this enhancement defaults to a Resilient TCP type configuration. If you want to continue using the Conventional TCP type, configure your existing probe to select Conventional TCP Type.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe and Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.

entries.title: Server Processing Time and Zscaler Time to First Byte
body: Zscaler adds two Web probe metrics called Server Processing Time and Zscaler Time to First Byte (ZTTFB) on the User Details page so that you can monitor the digital experience of a user accessing an application.

- Server Processing Time captures the duration from when the server processes a request to when it begins to send a response back. This metric specifically focuses on server-side processing aspects by measuring the efficiency of the server to generate a response.

- ZTTFB captures the duration from when a user's browser sends a request to an application until it receives the very first byte of data from the server. This includes the Redirect Time, TCP Connection, SSL Handshake Time, Server Processing Time, and Response Transmission Time. ZTTFB does not include DNS time. ZTTFB is a great indicator of a website's initial loading speed and server responsiveness.
See image.
You can also configure these two metrics as criteria for an application alert rule configuration.
There is an additional criteria for the application alert rule configuration called Server Processing Time. Zscaler Time to First Byte is used to replace the Server Response Time criteria.

entries.title: Enhanced Cloud Path Probe Configuration Options
body: Cloud Path probes include advanced configuration settings to improve network diagnostics and end-to-end performance measurements.

- Probing Type: Choose between SYN and SACK for traceroute methods when TCP is used as the protocol.
- Capture PMTU: Enable or disable Path Maximum Transmission Unit (PMTU) discovery to detect packet size limitations and fragmentation issues along the network path.
- DSCP Configuration: Set Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) values to define packet priority during network probes and monitor Quality of Service (QoS) changes along the path.

entries.title: Bandwidth Test for macOS
body: To start a Bandwidth Test as a Diagnostics session in the ZDX Admin Portal, users with macOS devices require Zscaler Client Connector version 4.3.1 and ZDX Module version 3.9.
To learn more, see Starting a New Diagnostics Session and Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.

entries.title: Hi-Fi Cloud Path
body: You can start a High Fidelity (Hi-Fi) Cloud Path diagnostics session. Hi-Fi Cloud Path provides additional information for network connectivity or latency based on the defined Cloud Path.
See image.
To learn more, see Starting a New Diagnostics Session.

entries.title: Workflow Automation Integration
body: ZDX supports the integration of the Workflow Automation Admin Portal that allows you to reroute alerts to the concerned team within your organization based on workflow rules. You can select Workflow Automation as a delivery method when configuring an alert rule. You can also configure a Workflow Automation when adding a SaaS Application Integration.
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Workflows for ZDX Alerts, Configuring SaaS Application Tenants for ZDX, and Configuring an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Improved Time Granularity for Data Explorer Views
body: Time intervals displayed in Data Explorer views have been updated to display more granularity, based on your selected time range.
To learn more, see Configuring Data Explorer Views.

entries.title: Wi-Fi Dashboard
body: The Wi-Fi Dashboard utilizes existing user and device Wi-Fi data in your organization to monitor device performance. This data can help identify specific locations in which users might have issues with their Wi-Fi access points.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the Wi-Fi Dashboard.

entries.title: ZDX Copilot Enhancements
body: ZDX Copilot enhancements include dynamic recommendations based on your chat session history, support for Web probe metrics, analytics for device health, and support and diagnostics for Wi-Fi and call quality issues.
To learn more, see About ZDX Copilot.

entries.title: ZDX Copilot
body: ZDX Copilot is an assistant powered by Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) and provides an expert, systematic approach through conversation. ZDX Admins can interact with ZDX Copilot to effectively enhance a user's experience in the ZDX Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About ZDX Copilot.

entries.title: Deep Tracing Renamed to Diagnostics on Navigation Menu and Page
body: An update was released that renamed the Deep Tracing term for the navigation menu and page to Diagnostics in the ZDX Admin Portal. Deep Tracing remains as a Diagnostics type. This doesn’t change any current functionality.
To learn more, see About Diagnostics.

entries.title: ZDX Admin Portal Login Update
body: The ZDX Admin Portal login process was updated to allow Zscaler to check if ZIdentity is enabled for your account depending on your Login ID.
See image.
To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the ZDX Admin Portal.

entries.title: ZDX Snapshot for Alert and Diagnostics Details
body: The ZDX Snapshot feature provides a URL that you can share with ZDX users for view-only access to a specific Alert or Diagnostics details page. ZDX Snapshot enables users without ZDX Admin Portal login access to view details with limited user interaction.
Make sure your subscription level supports ZDX Snapshot and your ZDX role has the proper permission level to share ZDX Snapshots.
See image.
To learn more, see Sharing ZDX Snapshots.

entries.title: ZPA Public Service Edge Incident Type
body: There is a new incident type on the Incidents Dashboard called ZPA Public Service Edge. The ZPA Public Service Edge incident type provides comprehensive key metrics on Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) traffic at the Zscaler Data Center.
An update was released that renamed Zscaler Data Center to ZIA Public Service Edge on the Incidents Dashboard. This doesn't change any current functionality.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the Incidents Dashboard.

entries.title: Data Explorer Views
body: Data Explorer provides the flexibility to create and organize your own customized views of applications and metrics to analyze data.
See image.
To learn more about the feature and its prerequisites, see Configuring Data Explorer Views.

entries.title: Download Data from Device Inventory
body: Download current device and user data in CSV format from Device Inventory.
See image.
To learn more about the feature and its prerequisites, see Viewing Device Inventory.

entries.title: Brownouts Subtype for Last Mile ISP
body: Brownouts is a subtype for Last Mile ISP (Internet Service Provider) on the Incidents Dashboard. Brownouts provide comprehensive key metrics on performance degradation on the Last Mile ISP.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the Incidents Dashboard.

entries.title: Deep Tracing for Android or Android on ChromeOS Devices
body: To start a Deep Tracing session in the ZDX Admin Portal, users with Android or Android on ChromeOS devices require Zscaler Client Connector version 3.7 and ZDX Module version 3.2 for Windows.
To learn more, see About Diagnostics and Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.

entries.title: ZDX Snapshot for Applications Overview
body: The ZDX Snapshot feature provides a URL that you can share with ZDX users for view-only access to the Applications Overview and application details pages. ZDX Snapshot enables users without ZDX Admin Portal login access to view the pages with limited user interaction.
See image.
To learn more about the feature and its prerequisites, see Sharing ZDX Snapshots.

entries.title: ZDX Score Alert Rule Type Removed
body: The ZDX Score alert rule type has been removed because it is no longer recommended for use. If you have an existing ZDX Score alert rule type, you must migrate it to an Application or Network rule type.
To learn more, see Editing an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Integration of Incidents in ZDX Score Over Time
body: Incident data can be enabled and displayed in the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page. To view the data, ensure your ZDX subscription level supports Incidents and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: OAuth for ServiceNow Webhook Authentication
body: You can use OAuth as an authentication type when configuring a webhook for ServiceNow.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Webhooks.

entries.title: Report for Top 100 Users with Poor ZDX Scores
body: The system-generated report for Top 100 Poor Score Users is available in the ZDX Admin Portal.
To view the report, make sure your subscription level supports system-generated reports and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: ZDX Score Alert Rule Type
body: The ZDX Score alert rule type is no longer recommended for use. Any existing ZDX Score alert rule type has migrated to an Application rule type. The correlation between ZDX Score and Application makes the alert more precise and dynamic by considering ZDX Score drops with the web and network metrics.
To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule and Editing an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Dashboard Filter for Operating System
body: A filter has been added to the Performance Overview, Applications Overview, and User Overview pages in the ZDX Admin Portal to specify operating systems on user devices in your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the ZDX Dashboard, Monitoring the Applications Dashboard, and Monitoring the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Report for Active Users by Zscaler Destination
body: The system-generated report for Active Users by Zscaler Destination is available in the ZDX Admin Portal.
To view the report, make sure your subscription level supports system-generated reports and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Location of Stored ZDX Data
body: ZDX logs and data are now stored in either the European Union (Western Europe, Netherlands) or Australia East (New South Wales).
Contact your Zscaler Account team for details.
To learn more about Zscaler's retention of logs and data, see ZDX Customer Logs and Data.

entries.title: Automated Analysis of Poor ZDX Scores
body: On the user details page, the application tile with the lowest Poor ZDX Score is preselected by default, and ZDX runs root cause analysis automatically on the most recent Poor score. Potential factors are provided that might have contributed to the score.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Option to Reverse Cloud Path
body: An option is available when configuring a probe to force a reverse Cloud Path. You can enable this setting when a network device blocks the forward Cloud Path and you're unable to reconfigure the device or firewall.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.

entries.title: Reports for ZDX Score by Applications and Wi-Fi Distribution
body: System-generated reports for ZDX Score by Applications and Wi-Fi Distribution are available in the ZDX Admin Portal.
To view the reports, make sure your subscription level supports system-generated reports and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Exclude Option for Alert Rule Configuration's Filters
body: You can exclude items from a filter while configuring an Alert Rule.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule and Editing an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Report for Application Performance
body: The system-generated report for Application Performance is available in the ZDX Admin Portal.
To view the report, make sure your subscription level supports system-generated reports and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Improved Filter Interaction
body: Filter interaction has been improved in the Performance Overview, Applications Overview, User Overview, Alerts, and Rules pages in the ZDX Admin Portal to include or exclude filter selections. The filter interaction has also been added to probing criteria when configuring a new probe.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the ZDX Dashboard and Monitoring the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Improved Search for Probes
body: Filters have been added to the Probes page to help identify specific probes when using Search.
See image.
To learn more, see About Probes.

entries.title: ZDX Autosense for Microsoft Teams Call Quality
body: ZDX Autosense dynamically detects the destination IP address and port for data traffic, and provides an automated Cloud Path probe when you onboard a Microsoft Teams Call Quality tenant.

Before you onboard a Microsoft Teams Call Quality tenant, make sure your ZDX subscription level supports ZDX Autosense, and you’re running the required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module. You must also enable a driver installation setting for ZDX Autosense in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Understanding Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX, Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility, Ranges & Limitations, and Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

entries.title: Detailed Metrics for Page Fetch Time
body: Granular metrics for Page Fetch Time are available for Advanced Plus users on the user details page. View additional graphs with details that show a breakdown of individual time metrics that comprise the overall Page Fetch Time.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: ZDX Autosense for Webex Call Quality
body: ZDX Autosense dynamically detects the destination IP address and port for data traffic, and provides an automated Cloud Path probe when you onboard a Webex Call Quality tenant.

Before you onboard a Webex Call Quality tenant, make sure your ZDX subscription level supports ZDX Autosense, and you’re running the required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module. You must also enable a driver installation setting for ZDX Autosense in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Webex Call Quality for ZDX, Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility, Ranges & Limitations, and Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

entries.title: Zoom Quality of Service Subscription
body: Zoom Call Quality for ZDX provides the option to onboard a Zoom Quality of Service Subscription (QSS) tenant instead of a Zoom API tenant.
Contact your Zscaler Account Manager to request access to this feature.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

entries.title: ZDX Integration on ServiceNow
body: ServiceNow integrates with ZDX’s Root Cause Analysis and Deep Tracing to provide insightful analytics on a user’s applications metrics when the ZDX Score drops.
See image.
To learn more, see ZDX Integration on ServiceNow.

entries.title: Self Service
body: Self Service allows users to resolve potential issues related to CPU usage and Wi-Fi access without the need to contact customer support. When enabled, an admin can review insights on how notifications are distributed to users on the Self-Service IT Overview dashboard.

Make sure your subscription level supports Self Service. To access the Self-Service IT Overview dashboard or to configure which users receive notifications, your ZDX role must have the proper permission level for Self-Service IT in the Add ZDX Role window.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Self Service Settings, Monitoring the Self Service Dashboard, Adding ZDX Roles, and Ranges and Limitations.

entries.title: Filter for Location Groups
body: A filter has been added to the Performance Overview, Applications Overview, and User Overview pages in the ZDX Admin Portal to specify location groups in your organization. The filter has also been added to probing criteria when configuring a new probe and rule filters when configuring an alert rule.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the ZDX Dashboard, Monitoring the Applications Dashboard, Configuring a Probe, and Configuring an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Incidents Dashboard
body: The Incidents Dashboard displays incidents, which are issues that affect the device performance of multiple users that ZDX detects in the areas of Wi-Fi, Last Mile ISP, Zscaler Data Centers, and Application.

Make sure your subscription level supports the Incidents Dashboard. Your ZDX admin role must have the proper permission level for Incidents in the Add ZDX Role window to access the Incidents Dashboard.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the Incidents Dashboard, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: ZDX Snapshot
body: The ZDX Snapshot feature provides a URL that you can share with ZDX users for view-only access of the user details page. ZDX Snapshot enables users without ZDX Admin Portal login access to view ZDX user details with limited user interaction.
Make sure your subscription level supports ZDX Snapshot and your ZDX role has the proper permission level to share ZDX Snapshots.
See image.
To learn more, see Sharing ZDX Snapshots, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Additional System-Generated Reports
body: System-generated reports for Last Mile ISP Performance and DNS Performance are available in the ZDX Admin Portal.
To view the reports, make sure your subscription level supports system-generated reports and your ZDX role has the proper permission level.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports, Ranges & Limitations, and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Bandwidth Test for Deep Tracing Session
body: You can select a bandwidth test when you start a Deep Tracing Session on a user’s device.
See image.
To learn more, see Starting a New Deep Tracing Session.

entries.title: Labels
body: You can manage labels and review label details on the Labels page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Labels and Managing Labels.

entries.title: ZDX Autosense for Zoom Call Quality
body: ZDX Autosense dynamically detects the destination IP address and port for data traffic, and provides an automated Cloud Path probe when you onboard a Zoom Call Quality tenant.

Before you onboard a Zoom Call Quality tenant, make sure your ZDX subscription level supports ZDX Autosense, and you’re running the required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module. You must also enable a driver installation setting for ZDX Autosense in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX, Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility, Ranges & Limitations, and Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

entries.title: External Proxy in Cloud Path
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) supports traceroute scenarios in the Cloud Path when an External Proxy is detected.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating the Cloud Path.

entries.title: Process Inventory
body: Process Inventory allows you to monitor processes that might be impacting the behavior of your users' devices. Process calculations are updated in one-minute rolling intervals, and the top processes are displayed every five minutes.
To monitor the processes, you first need to set a CPU usage threshold for devices in your organization. Minimum versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module are also required.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing Process Inventory, Configuring Inventory Settings, and Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.

entries.title: Dynamic Alerting
body: You can create a dynamic alert by configuring the alert rule type to network or application and selecting the ZDX Score or ZDX Score Drops parameter.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule, Evaluating Individual Alert Details, and Triggering an Alert.

entries.title: Filter for User Groups
body: A filter has been added to the Performance Overview, Applications Overview, and User Overview pages in the ZDX Admin Portal to specify user groups in your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the ZDX Dashboard and Monitoring the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Quarterly Business Review Reports
body: Download Quarterly Business Review (QBR) reports from the ZDX Admin Portal for insights into how Zscaler is helping protect your network. The reports can help you understand emerging traffic trends and the types of threats that Zscaler is blocking.
To access the reports, your ZDX role must have the proper permission level for Analytics in the Add ZDX Role window.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Quarterly Business Review Reports and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: System-Generated Reports
body: View system-generated reports in the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Admin Portal that detail aggregated user data across your organization.
To view the reports, your ZDX role for Analytics must have the Full or View Only permission level in the Add ZDX Role window.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing System-Generated Reports and Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Managing Top Private Applications
body: You can manage your Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) applications in ZDX in the Configuration Portal (Configuration > Applications > Top Private Apps).
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Top Private Applications.

entries.title: SIPA in Web Probe Metrics
body: Web probe traffic forwarded through Source IP Anchoring (SIPA) is highlighted in the graphs for Web Probe Metrics.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Inventory Management for Admin Access
body: You can configure the permission settings for Inventory Management from the Add ZDX Role dialog window in Role Management.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: ISP Filtering
body: A filter has been added to the Performance Overview, Applications Overview, and User Overview pages in the ZDX Admin Portal to select the Internet Service Provider (ISP) for users in your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Monitoring the ZDX Dashboard and Monitoring the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Time Duration for Admin Access
body: You can select a time duration or Full Access for your Help Desk roles with other granular permissions levels in the Add ZDX Role window.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Webex Call Quality for ZDX
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) supports Webex Call Quality to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants in a configured Webex tenant. Call Quality works in parallel with cloud path probes, device metrics, and device events to help you identify issues that are unique to a device, application, or network.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Webex Call Quality for ZDX and Understanding Webex Call Quality for ZDX.

entries.title: Additional Predefined Applications
body: Microsoft Login, Okta, and Webex (web app) are available as predefined applications in the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Predefined Applications for ZDX.

entries.title: Redirects for Predefined Applications
body: To ensure accurate performance measurements, the setting for Follow Redirect is disabled by default when configuring a web probe for the following predefined applications:
- Box
- Microsoft Teams Web App
- OneDrive for Business
- Outlook Online
- ServiceNow
- SharePoint Online
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.

entries.title: Department Selection for an Admin’s Scope
body: The scope criteria in the Add ZDX Admin or Edit ZDX Admin window has been updated to allow the selection of Department.
See image.

entries.title: Remote Assistance Device Information Obfuscation
body: In the Remote Assistance window, an admin can set their Device Information to Visible or Obfuscated.
See image.

entries.title: Reference Line in Impacted User Devices Chart
body: A dotted reference line was added to the Impacted User Devices chart on an individual Alert Details page. This reference line is based on the criteria set from configuring an alert rule.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating Individual Alert Details.

entries.title: Alert Details Enhancements
body: You can view the total and list of impacted devices per department, geolocation, or locations more readily.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating Individual Alert Details.

entries.title: Alert Rule Copy Capability
body: You can copy the details of an existing rule in the Rules overview on the Alerts page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Rules.

entries.title: Citrix Support in Cloud Path
body: When Citrix is the network interface for TCP or UDP probes, Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) displays the path to the VPN Concentrator.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating the Cloud Path.

entries.title: Network Interface Types in Cloud Path
body: Network interface detection for cellular, Bluetooth, and USB types is represented in the hop view, as applicable.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Packet Capture in Deep Tracing
body: You can enable Packet Capture (PCAP) for network trafficking in Deep Tracing Sessions.
See image.
To learn more, see About Deep Tracing, Evaluating Deep Tracing Session Information, and Starting a New Deep Tracing Session.

entries.title: Salesforce Applications
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) supports both Salesforce Classic and the Salesforce Lightning interface as predefined applications.
See image.
To learn more, see Predefined Applications for ZDX.

entries.title: ZDX Score Map Enhancements
body: The user interaction for the Regions by ZDX Score maps has been enhanced in the Performance Overview and Applications details pages, including the addition of a tooltip icon that links to the User Overview page.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard and About the Applications Dashboard.

entries.title: Microsoft Endpoint Analytics for ZDX
body: Microsoft Endpoint Analytics helps identify issues with user software or devices that might be impacting performance and reliability. Metrics are garnered from the Microsoft Intune API and mapped to individual ZDX users and devices to provide Endpoint Analytics scores and data.
Contact your Zscaler Account Manager to request access to this feature.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Microsoft Intune for ZDX and Understanding Microsoft Endpoint Analytics for ZDX.

entries.title: Compare ZDX Scores
body: Compare two time points in the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view differences in ZDX Score data. The feature utilizes web, device, and cloud path metrics to help determine differences in scoring.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Depiction of Disabled and Deleted Applications and Probes
body: The distinction between disabled and deleted applications and probes in the ZDX Admin Portal UI has been updated. Disabled application and probe names are indicated in grey, and deleted application names are indicated via strikethrough.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard and About the Applications Dashboard.

entries.title: Device Time Zone in Hop View
body: Upon hover, the device profile in the Cloud Path Hop View includes the Device Time Zone.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Software and Device Inventory
body: View current and historical information about software versions and updates on user devices, as well as current information about the devices and associated users. You can access Software Inventory and Device Inventory in the Inventory menu.
See image.
In order to view Inventory data, you must enable Inventory Data Collection under the Inventory Settings in the Administration menu and run Zscaler Client Connector version 3.3 or later for Windows.
See image.
To learn more, see About Software Inventory, About Device Inventory, and Configuring Inventory Settings. Contact your Zscaler Account Manager to request access to this feature.

entries.title: Granular Permissions and Obfuscation
body: You can assign granular permissions for your Help Desk roles with the updated permissions levels on the Add ZDX Role window.
If an admin has obfuscation assigned and is unable to see the required information, review the obfuscation settings in the permissions levels.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles, About ZDX Service Desk Role, and About ZDX Role-based Administration.

entries.title: ZDX API Key Management
body: You can create or manage an API key on the API Key Management page.
See image.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to request access to this feature.
To learn more, see About API Key Management.

entries.title: ServiceNow Incident Management Integration with ZDX
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) supports the integration of ServiceNow Incident Management in a ServiceNow instance to automatically create incidents when alerts are triggered.
See image.
To learn more about ServiceNow Incident Management, see the ServiceNow Store.
To learn more about webhook configuration for ServiceNow Incident Management, see Configuring Webhooks for ServiceNow.

entries.title: Alert Statuses
body: You can view alert statuses on the Alerts page.
See image.
To learn more, see Understanding the Alert Status.

entries.title: Default Packet Count for Cloud Path Probes
body: The default packet count for new cloud path probes has been updated from 11 to 5 for predefined and custom applications for all subscription levels.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe and Editing a Probe.

entries.title: Time Range Analysis for Poor ZDX Scores
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) helps identify potential reasons for Poor ZDX Scores within a specified time range. Click Analyze Range within the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view contributing factors and explanations.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Monitoring Criteria for ZDX Call Quality Applications
body: When adding a new tenant in Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Call Quality applications for Microsoft Teams and Zoom, Monitoring Criteria filters are now provided to help identify users who are meeting hosts. Only meetings hosted by these users are monitored.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX and Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

entries.title: Analysis for Poor ZDX Scores
body: Digital Experience (ZDX) can now help identify potential reasons for a Poor ZDX Score at a specific date and time. Click Analyze Score within the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view factors and explanations for the low score.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

entries.title: Admin Access to Zscaler Client Connector Portal
body: You can now configure admin permissions for Zscaler Client Connector Portal access by using the Add ZDX Role pop-up in Role Management.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: ZDX API
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports the use of APIs for programmatic access to ZDX data. This allows you to integrate analytics tools and ITSM solutions. API access requires an API key to authenticate in order to retrieve data.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to request access to the API Key Management feature.
To learn more, see About the ZDX API and About API Key Management.

entries.title: Device Location Icon in Hop View
body: The cloud path hop view now displays an icon to indicate a device location was determined by latitude and longitude coordinates, rather than IP address.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Reverse Traceroute in Cloud Path
body: The cloud path now displays underlay hops to show the routing path for GRE tunnels.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: ZIA Private Service Edge in Cloud Path
body: The Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Private Service Edge is now displayed in the cloud path hop view for private networks.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: UCaaS Monitoring
body: You can now configure UCaaS Monitoring permissions for access to Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Call Quality applications.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: Baseline for Page Fetch Time
body: A Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) score baseline is now provided in the Page Fetch Time graph on the user details page. For predefined applications, the baseline represents an average score based on device metrics across all organizations. For custom applications, the baseline represents an average score based on device metrics from a given organization.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Protocol for Adaptive Probes
body: The Cloud Path Hop View now shows the grouping of protocol with tunnel type for Adaptive probes.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: NDR Support
body: The Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) cloud path now supports No Default Route (NDR) deployments to the Zscaler cloud.

entries.title: Messaging for Data Availability
body: On the User Overview page, messaging has been added to the end of trend lines for Total Active Users and Total Active Devices for the last few minutes if complete data is not yet available from all connected devices.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Support for ZPA Private Service Edge and Web Probe Rate Limiting
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge in the cloud path and web probe rate limits for internal applications through ZPA. The following versions are required for this ZPA support:
- App Connector: 21.352.1
- Windows: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.1 (with ZDX Module 3.1 for Windows)
- macOS: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6 (with ZDX Module 3.1 for macOS)
To learn more about ZPA in the cloud path and rate limiting, see About the Users Dashboard and About ZDX Web Probe Rate Limiting.

entries.title: Zoom Call Quality for ZDX
body: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports Zoom Call Quality to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants in a configured Zoom tenant. The user and device information for call participants is mapped directly to ZDX users and devices. Call Quality works in parallel with cloud path probes and device metrics and events to help you identify issues that are unique to a device, application, or network.
Zoom Call Quality is currently limited by the Zoom API rate limit of 60K probes per day, and may be affected by other Zoom applications using the API.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX and About Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

entries.title: ZDX Setup Wizard
body: As part of the Standard subscription plan, ZDX supports an onboarding wizard for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) admins who have full admin and policy access to quickly enable the ZDX service. The wizard also allows admins to add the ZDX admin role to other existing ZIA admins or to new admins. This wizard is now fully supported on all Zscaler clouds for ZIA.
See image.
To learn more, see Using the ZDX Setup Wizard and About Notification.

entries.title: Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX
body: ZDX now supports Microsoft Teams Call Quality to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants in a configured Microsoft Teams tenant. User and device information garnered from Microsoft for call participants is mapped directly to ZDX users and devices. Call Quality works in parallel with Cloud Path probes and device metrics and events to help you identify issues that are unique to a device, application, or network.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX and About Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX.

entries.title: ZDX Setup Wizard
body: As part of the Standard subscription plan, ZDX now supports an onboarding wizard for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) admins who have full admin and policy access to quickly enable the ZDX service. The wizard also allows admins to add the ZDX admin role to other existing ZIA admins or to new admins.
See image.
To learn more, see Using the ZDX Setup Wizard and About Notification.

entries.title: CSV Download from User Overview Page
body: You can now download a CSV file from the User Overview page. The CSV file reflects the current table view for each ZDX Score category (Poor, Okay, or Good).
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: ZPA Support in ZDX
body: ZDX now supports Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) on Windows platforms to measure internal application performance and display the end-to-end Cloud Path up to the internal application front door. Data is encrypted and stored at rest before being shipped to the ZDX infrastructure using HTTPS. Zscaler Client Connector version 3.6.1 for Windows and App Connector 21.224.1 are required for this ZPA support.
See image.
To learn more about ZPA in the Cloud Path and how to configure a probe, see Evaluating the Cloud Path and Configuring a Probe.
To learn more about deployment recommendations for ZPA to work with ZDX, see App Connector Deployment Prerequisites.

entries.title: Consistent Behavior for Logout and Timeout
body: When you log out from the ZDX Admin Portal or are logged out because of a session timeout, the Time Range Filter is reset to 2 hours and all other filters are cleared.
When you log in after a session timeout, you will land on the page to which you were navigating when the timeout occurred.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Admin Portal.

entries.title: Deep Tracing PDF Enhancements
body: The page layout for Deep Tracing PDF files has been improved to include logical page and line breaks.
To learn more, see About Deep Tracing.

entries.title: UI Enhancements for Unknown Locations
body: The geolocations filter on the dashboard and Alerts pages is now streamlined to display only one instance of "Unknown" when city, state, and country are all unknown locations.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard.

entries.title: Multiple Cloud Support for SAML Login from IdP
body: In cases where tenants are defined on multiple Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) clouds and have a common domain, you can now configure an IdP for admins to authenticate with a specific ZIA cloud.

Enter the ZIA cloud domain name (e.g., zscalertwo.net) in the Relay State field of your IdP configuration settings to authenticate with the ZIA cloud. You may need to create an IdP application for each ZIA cloud.

entries.title: Option to View Current ZDX Score
body: You can now view the most-current ZDX Score by clicking Current Score, located on the ZDX dashboard, User Overview dashboard, and User details page. The ZDX Score will reflect a time range for the previous 30 minutes.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard.

entries.title: Time Range Retained for ZDX Score
body: When you select an application and zoom in to capture a time range within the graph for ZDX Score Over Time, that time range is now retained when navigating to the User Overview and User details pages.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Applications Dashboard.

entries.title: Enhancements to User Device Events
body: The user interface for User Device Events has been enhanced to include improved tooltips and the ability to filter device event categories.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Time Zone Added to Dashboard Graphs
body: The time zone has been added to the beginning and ending of time lines in applicable graphs for the ZDX dashboard, Users dashboard, and Applications dashboard.
See image.

entries.title: Tunnels in Cloud Path Hop View
body: Tunnel type names have been updated for clarity, and the Hop View now shows a more precise starting point for a tunnel within the cloud path.

entries.title: User and Application Filters Included in New Tab
body: When right-clicking the username in the Users Overview or the application name in the Applications Overview, using "Open link in new tab" will now carry over the applicable filters to the new browser tab.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard and About the Applications Dashboard.

entries.title: Edit Protocols for Predefined Cloud Path Probes
body: Users can now change the protocol port for predefined cloud path probes after initial configuration.
See image.
To learn more, see About Probes.

entries.title: SAML Support for ZDX Admin Login
body: You can now configure SAML authentication for ZDX admins to log in to the ZDX Admin Portal directly from your single sign-on provider portal. An IdP (such as ADFS or Okta) must already be configured for your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring SAML for ZDX Admins.

entries.title: ZDX Roles for Deep Tracing, Alerts, and Webhooks
body: Admin roles can now be configured in ZDX for specific permissions to access, configure, and manage Deep Tracing, Alerts, and Webhooks.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

entries.title: ZDX Score for Alert Configuration
body: You can now create Alert rules for your ZDX Score. If you configure a new rule and choose ZDX Score as your Rule Type, you can set criteria to be alerted when the score changes.
See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts and Configuring a Rule.

entries.title: Adaptive Mode Protocol for Probe Configuration
body: You can now configure probes using the Adaptive mode protocol option. If you choose Adaptive mode, the best protocol for each leg in the cloud path is selected via an auto-discovery process.
See image.
To learn more, see About Adaptive Mode.

entries.title: Device and Device Metrics Selections in the User Page Retained
body: The device selected in the User Devices Section as well as the Device Health metrics selections in the User page will be retained across navigation and login.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Enhanced User Devices Section in the User Page
body: The User Devices section in the User page can now display information for multiple devices, as well as additional network, hardware, and software device details.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Filter Separation between the Probe and the Dashboard pages
body: Filters applied on the Probe configuration page will not carry over to the Users dashboard page and vice versa.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard and About Probes.

entries.title: Maximum of the Zscaler Latency and Egress ISP in the Cloud Path
body: The maximum of the Zscaler latency to the hop on either side will be indicated above the ZIA Public Service Edge icon in the Cloud Path section. Clicking the magnifying glass icons displays the expanded view with the maximum Zscaler latency on top of the relevant hop. The egress service provider will also be displayed under the egress node.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Cloud Path Enhancements
body: The following enhancements are now available in the Cloud Path
# Selectable Latency Graphs per Leg in the Cloud Path
Latency over the different legs will now display in the Cloud Path section in the User page. This option can also be selected in the checkbox below the graph.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
# Location Enhancements

Service provider information will display for hops in the Cloud Path. Geo information and the Zscaler location will display for the device, and geo information will also display for the Zscaler node in both the Hop View and the Command Line View.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: User Search Enhancements
body: A recently deleted user profile will now be displayed in the User Search results as well as in the search history.
See image.
To learn more, see Using User Search in the ZDX Admin Portal.

entries.title: Users Dashboard Optimization
body: The ZDX score processing on the Users Dashboard is now optimized so that the score rendering on the page loads faster for users.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Cloud Path Probe Configuration Enhancements
body: When configuring a cloud path probe for predefined applications, following a web probe is the default value. It is also recommended when configuring cloud path probes for custom applications.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.

entries.title: Deep Tracing Session Results Enhancements
body: The Deep Tracing session results charts will now display raw metrics without aggregation. If there is no data, this will be indicated by a gap in the charts as well as an error message.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing Deep Tracing Session Results.

entries.title: Location Management in the ZDX Admin Portal
body: Admins can now view the Location Management page in the ZDX Admin Portal by going to Administration > Location Management.
See image.
To learn more, see About Locations.

entries.title: Alerts Page Enhancements
body: The information in the Alerts page is now organized into Ongoing alerts and Alert History tabs for easy access to alert details.
See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts.

entries.title: Cloud Path Enhancements
body: The following enhancements are now available in the Users Dashboard.
# View Cloud Path from the Zscaler Client Connector to ZPA

When accessing an internet application, you can see the cloud path from the Zscaler Client Connector to the application and if there is a ZIA Public Service Edge in the path, that will also be displayed in the User page. If a private application is accessed, you can view the cloud path from the Zscaler Client Connector to the ZPA Public Service Edge or the ZPA Private Service Edge.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
# Differential Latency in the Cloud Path
You can now see differential latency over the different legs of the cloud path and the leg with the highest latency displays in orange.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
# Cloud Path Error Messages in the Command Line View
If there are any errors in the cloud path, they will now be indicated by an icon next to the IP address in the Command Line View. Clicking the icon will display the error message.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard and Cloud Path Errors.

entries.title: Location Enhancements
body: The following location enhancements are now available.
# Hierarchical Location Display in the ZDX Dashboard
In the ZDX dashboard, the Active Geolocations filter now offers a hierarchical display of locations for easy selection and filtering.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard.
# Regions by ZDX Score Map in the Applications Page
The Regions by ZDX Score map is now available in the Applications page and provides greater functionality for viewing details and filtering information.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Applications Dashboard.

entries.title: Smooth ZDX Score in the User Page
body: In the ZDX Score Over Time graph in the User page, the Smooth ZDX Score, which uses historical data to reduce short-term variations in the ZDX Score, displays. You can also select the checkbox below the graph to view the ZDX score.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Cloud Path Error Messages in the Users Page
body: In the Cloud Path section of the Users Page, icons will display in case of any errors. Click the link below the error message to view further details.
See image.
To learn more, see Cloud Path Errors.

entries.title: Enhanced User Search
body: The User Search in the ZDX Admin Portal will now display the 10 most relevant results of a search. Clicking Load More will display 10 more results consecutively till complete.
See image.
To learn more, see Using User Search in the ZDX Admin Portal.

entries.title: Deep Tracing for macOS Devices
body: Users with macOS devices running Zscaler Client Connector 3.0.0.93 (and later) and ZDX 2.0.0.2 (and later) can now start Deep Tracing sessions in the ZDX Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Deep Tracing.

entries.title: Predefined applications for Microsoft Teams and Zoom
body: Microsoft Teams and Zoom are now predefined applications and can be seen in the Applications tab of the Configurations page. Onboarding these applications will automatically enable web and cloud path probes for them in the ZDX Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Applications.

entries.title: Change Password from the Account Page
body: ZDX admins can now change their password from their account page. An update made here will apply to both the ZDX and ZIA Admin Portals.
See image.
To learn more, see Customizing Your Admin Account Settings.

entries.title: Cloud Path Enhancement
body: The Cloud Path section of the Users Dashboard will now show the location of the egress, ZIA Public Service Edge, and destination in the Hop View.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: EUSA in the ZDX Admin Portal
body: An End User Subscription Agreement (EUSA) appears in the ZDX Admin Portal when you log in for the first time. Per organization, one admin is required to accept the agreement. You will have Read-Only access in the Portal till the EUSA is accepted.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Admin Portal.

entries.title: Cloud Path Enhancement
body: The Cloud Path section of the Users Dashboard will now show a 4-digit number for the ZIA Public Service Edge (formerly known as Zscaler Enforcement Node or ZEN) in the Hop View and Cloud Path View. This hash value will help Zscaler Support locate and troubleshoot any issues faster.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Password Expiration in the ZDX Admin Portal
body: You can now configure Password Expiration for ZDX admins in the ZDX Admin Portal or the ZIA Admin Portal. The latest password expiration settings configured in either portal will apply in both locations.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Password Expiration.

entries.title: Web Probe Updates
body: Page Fetch Time, collected by the web probes, will now only request the top-level page document and will not request embedded links contained in the web page. This will provide users with a metric similar to other developer tools.
See image.
To learn more, see About Probes.

entries.title: Deep Tracing
body: Deep Tracing in ZDX can provide greater insight into process-level information for a selected user's device. During a Deep Tracing session, information is collected every minute for the web probe, cloud path probe, as well as device statistics to analyze any issues that users may be facing.
See image.
To learn more, see About Deep Tracing.

entries.title: User Details Page Enhancements
body: In the User details page, admins can now flexibly view and sort user information by application. Select one or more applications in the Applications filter drop-down to view user information on the rest of the page.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Users Dashboard Enhancements
body: The following enhancements are now available for the Users Dashboard.
# Web Probe Errors in the Web Probe Metrics Section
In the Web Probe Metrics section of the Users Dashboard, icons will display in case of any issues. Clicking the icon will display error information for all the graphs in the section.
See image.
To learn more, see Web Probe Errors and About the Users Dashboard.
# Tunnel Information in the Cloud Path Section
In the Cloud Path section of the Users Dashboard, you can now view the flow of traffic through the applicable tunnels as per the configured policies.
See image.
To learn more, see About Tunnel Information in the Cloud Path and About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Users Dashboard Enhancements
body: In the Users Dashboard, select one or more applications in the Applications filter drop-down to view user information in the ZDX Score User Distribution and the Users list.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Zoom In/Out Feature for the Applications and Users Dashboards
body: In the ZDX Score graph in the Applications and Users Dashboards, you can use the plus (+) icon to select a time period to zoom in on for greater detail. The interval chosen in the ZDX Score Over Time graph will be reflected on the rest of the page.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Applications Dashboard and About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Alerts in ZDX
body: You can now monitor application, device, and network performance by using alerts in ZDX for different types of events. Admins can select from various criteria to configure rules that trigger alerts when a preset threshold is reached. Triggered alerts can then be viewed in the ZDX Admin Portal or delivered via email or webhook.
See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts.

entries.title: Application Selector for ZDX Score and Page Fetch Time
body: In the ZDX Dashboard, you can use the application selector for the ZDX Score and the Page Fetch Time to compare multiple applications.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard.

entries.title: Remote Assistance Available
body: Users can now allow Zscaler Support to securely and remotely log in to the ZDX Admin Portal for a limited period of time to troubleshoot any issues.
To learn more, see Enabling Remote Assistance.

entries.title: Command Line View of the Cloud Path Probe
body: The Command Line View of the Cloud Path probe is now available in the User Overview dashboard. Users can view probe details including the Hop Direction (to egress and destination), Region and Geolocation, Packet Loss (%) and Packets Failed, as well as Latency metrics.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

entries.title: Cloud Path Probe Enhancements
body: Users can now select Packet Interval and Packet Timeout configuration options for Cloud Path Probes.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.

entries.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) Access to the Zscaler Client Connector Portal
body: Users can now directly access the Zscaler Client Connector Portal from the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Admin Portal.
To learn more, see About the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
